d:
A wedding is never just one day when there's a whole celebration to prepare for! Go behind the scenes of American Gypsy weddings as the preparations, traditions and festivities come together to create memorable wedding celebrations.
Get a closer look at the wedding planning, bridal moments, family involvement and the celebrations that bring these occasions to life. From the anticipation before the ceremony to the energy of the wedding festivities, these moments capture the distinctive world of Gypsy wedding traditions.
